preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' or c == '*' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String `s` contains only lowercase Latin letters and at most one wildcard character '*'

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String `t` contains only lowercase Latin letters
Lengths of `s` and `t` are exactly `n` and `m` respectively, as given in input
`s` contains at most one wildcard character '*'

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (s.replace('*', '') == '' and t == '') or (s.replace('*', '') == t and '*' not in s) or (any((s[:i] + s[i+1:]).replace('*', '') == t for i in range(len(s)) if s[i] == '*')) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output is 'YES' if and only if `t` can be obtained by replacing the wildcard '*' in `s` with an arbitrary sequence of lowercase letters (including empty), otherwise 'NO'
